notes:
- **Voices gets better with every meeting: tune up voices from meetings you've confirmed, automatically or on demand.** A9 Voice now keeps the short stretches of speech each voice was built from, so **Tune up now** (and **Keep voices tuned up**, on by default) can rebuild a voice without the stretch where two people talked, show what changed for each person and undo it. The first start reads your past meetings once, in the background, to fill them in. See [Tune up your voices](/docs/voices/#tune-up-your-voices).
- **Rank people by how often you meet them and clean out people you met once.** The People list counts meetings from your notes, marks people you meet again and again as Core, and filters by Core, Heard once and Not heard in 60 days. Select several people and forget them with one confirmation. See [Voices](/docs/voices/#the-voices-page).
- **Savings now counts every add-on your speech service bills, so the monthly estimate matches your bill.** AssemblyAI and Deepgram charge extra for speaker labels and for your Dictionary's words, after the call and live; the estimate left them out. The card for the engine you use is now made from what it really billed in the last 30 days, the others from the price table with the add-ons your settings turn on, and the basis is written under the cards. See [Savings](/docs/usage-and-cost/#savings).
- **Choose who writes the live transcript in Settings › Live window.** **Live transcript by** replaces the Deepgram switch: Automatic, AssemblyAI, Deepgram or a speech model on this PC, each with its price an hour. A choice whose key or model is gone falls back to Automatic and says so. A saved **Use Deepgram for the live transcript** is kept as the choice Deepgram. See [Live window](/docs/live-window/).
- **Dictionary words go to the after-call pass by default; the live transcript can use them too if you turn it on.** **Use Dictionary words in the live transcript** is off to begin with, since the finished note rewrites every line anyway, and a cloud live stream bills the words as an add-on.
- **Automatic now tells speakers apart on this PC during the call when the speaker model is installed (free).** Before, a live transcript from Deepgram or AssemblyAI always paid for the service's speaker labels. See [Speakers on this PC](/docs/speakers-on-this-pc/).
